parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html operation to obtain the name of the database.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the name of a physical database.
You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the name of a logical database
parameters.help_zh:

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database. The database can be a physical database or a logical database.

To obtain the ID of a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.
To obtain the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId），数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：
物理库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。
